conditional_simple.overview: El Condicional Simple expresa la posibilidad sobre la realización de una acción en el presente, pasado o futuro. Generalmente la realización de estas acciones depende de una condición.

construction.rule: INFINITIVO + terminaciones (ía, ías, ía, íamos, íais, ían)
construction.note: Same endings for -AR, -ER, -IR verbs; same stem irregularities as future tense

irregular_stems.note: Uses the SAME irregular stems as the future tense

uses.name: Possible Action in the Present (with implicit condition)
uses.description: Expresses what would happen now, given a hypothetical condition

examples.spanish: Yo podría ir a tu fiesta pero tengo que terminar mi tarea.
examples.english: I could go to your party, but I have to finish my homework.
examples.explanation: Present possibility, condition implied (if I didn't have homework)

examples.spanish: Si tengo tiempo, comería una pizza.
examples.english: If I have time, I would eat a pizza.
examples.explanation: Conditional based on a present condition

uses.name: Possible Action in the Past
uses.description: Expresses what would have happened or could have happened, referring to a past situation

examples.spanish: ¿Qué pasaría ayer en el evento de surf?
examples.english: What would/could have happened yesterday at the surf event?

uses.name: Possible Action in the Future
uses.description: Expresses future possibility, often softer/more tentative than future simple

examples.spanish: Mañana me gustaría ir a la playa.
examples.english: Tomorrow I would like to go to the beach.

uses.name: Polite Requests
uses.description: Using conditional to soften requests, making them more polite

examples.explanation: Polite request using conditional of poder

examples.spanish: Me gustaría un café, por favor.
examples.english: I would like a coffee, please.

uses.name: Hypothetical Situations (If-clauses)
uses.description: Used in the result clause of hypothetical if-sentences (si + imperfect subjunctive, conditional)

examples.spanish: Si tuviera dinero, viajaría por el mundo.
examples.english: If I had money, I would travel the world.
examples.explanation: Classic hypothetical structure: si + imperfect subjunctive, + conditional

examples.spanish: Si tengo la oportunidad de verte, te invitaría una copa de vino.
examples.english: If I have the chance to see you, I would treat you to a glass of wine.
examples.explanation: Conditional as the result of a possible future condition

uses.name: Advice or Suggestions
uses.description: Giving advice using conditional (often with deber)

examples.spanish: Yo que tú, hablaría con ella.
examples.english: If I were you, I would talk to her.

uses.name: Future-in-the-Past (Reported Speech)
uses.description: Expressing what someone said would happen, from a past reference point

examples.english: He said he would come tomorrow.
examples.explanation: Conditional used for future relative to a past statement

vocabulary_notes.example: Me di cuenta de que era tarde.
